{{Quote|Great job, Jedi! The turbolaser just disappeared from our screens. It's been destroyed.|[[Asha (Naboo)|Asha]] to Kenobi|<ref name="SW:OW" />}}
The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] used a quad '''turbolaser cannon''' during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="SW:OW" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> The [[Quad turbolaser cannon/Legends|Quad turbolaser cannon]], which fired its barrels sequentially, was placed on a balcony overlooking a garden south of the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. The turbolaser cannon had four barrels and a sloping front. On either side were power conduits. During the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle to retake]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the cannon's range was long enough to prevent the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo Security Force]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] from taking off to attack the Droid Control Ship, [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Vuutun Palaa]], in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. The cannon was destroyed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when he used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to slice through the two power conduits.<ref name="SW:OW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The quad-barreled "turbolaser cannon" appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']].
